about: How each name in the app's text is written in each language. keep: as in English in every language (stations, stops, lines, streets; companies, agencies, services and products; text to type). official: the maker's own name in each language (for Apple Maps: Apple's web page in that language; without one, the Maps app's name on a Mac in that language, with Apple; English where the Mac has no such language; for Google Maps: the name Google Maps itself shows in that language). place: places and landmarks, the name most used in the language (its Wikipedia article's title), or English where there is none. Every language has an entry for every official and place name, also when it is English. Several forms are listed where the grammar changes the name; typed lists sentences where the name is text to type and stays English. CatchTextTests checks the translations against this list.
